device.category: hybrid-analogue duophonic/quad synthesizer, 37 semi-weighted keys with channel aftertouch, dual OSCar-style filter
device.based_on: Last design concept of Chris Huggett (EDP Wasp, OSCar), completed by Paul Whittington and team (UK, 2023); 'Wasp' engine with an 'OSCar' dual filter.

architecture.polyphony_mode: two analogue signal paths: Mono, Duophonic (one voice per path, each with its own filter in the 12 dB modes) or Quad (four voices; can combine with dual filters); voice spread across the stereo filters
architecture.patch_memory_note: 200 patches in RAM: Bank A 100 factory (A00-A99, protectable), Bank B 100 user (initial patch); compare, init, randomise.
architecture.summary: Per path: Oscillator 1 and 2, mathematically generated (sine, triangle, saw, pulse, organ or a wavetable: the 7-segment Mantis special or nine 256-byte OSCar tables) with shape, shape mod and pitch mod depths and octave; an Osc 1 sub an octave down; Osc 2 with semitone, cent and a density (detune) oscillator; drift; noise with decimation; ring mod. A three-stage balance mixer (Osc 1/2, oscillators/noise, then against ring mod). A dual state-variable filter on SSI2164 VCAs: LP/BP/HP at 12 dB (one filter per voice, duophonic) or 24 dB, plus wide band (series) and wide notch (parallel) with WIDTH, drive, key track and cutoff/width modulation. Analogue VCAs under Env 1. Two envelopes (sustain fall, repeat, bipolar velocity), two LFOs (fade in/out, sync, one-shot). Six mod routes multiply a SOURCE by a SCALE into a CONTROL. Chorus and reverb, arpeggiator, joystick.

modules.name: Keyboard, joystick and voicing
modules.description: 37 semi-weighted velocity keys with channel aftertouch; octave shift; Mono, Duophonic or Quad; glide (auto); joystick bend, vibrato, hold.

modules.name: Oscillator 1
modules.description: Mathematically generated oscillator (Huggett): sine, triangle, saw, pulse, organ or wavetable; SHAPE (harmonics, slope or pulse width); shape and pitch modulation depths; octave -3 to +2.

modules.name: Oscillator 2
modules.description: Mathematically generated oscillator (Huggett): sine, triangle, saw, pulse, organ or wavetable; SHAPE (harmonics, slope or pulse width); shape and pitch modulation depths; octave -3 to +2. With semitone, cent and a density oscillator.

modules.name: Osc 1 sub
modules.description: Follows Oscillator 1's settings one octave below.

modules.name: Noise
modules.description: Noise with a decimation (density) control for complexity.

modules.name: Mixer (three balance stages)
modules.description: Osc balance (1 against 2, sub added), noise balance (oscillators against noise), ring mod balance (oscillators + noise against ring mod).

modules.name: Dual filter
modules.description: Two multimode state-variable filters on SSI2164 VCAs per path: LP12, BP12, HP12 (duophonic: one per voice path), LP24, BP24, HP24, wide band (series), wide notch (parallel); WIDTH sets their spread; drive; key track.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Multi-stage analogue VCAs; Env 1 normalised to amplitude.

modules.name: Envelope 1
modules.description: ADSR with SUST FALL (sustain slopes during key-down), REPEAT (looping), bipolar VELOCITY, legato option. Normalised to amplitude.

modules.name: LFO 1
modules.description: LFO with FADE (in or out), wave, SYNC (free, sync, one shot) and RATE; key trigger option.

modules.name: Envelope 2
modules.description: ADSR with SUST FALL (sustain slopes during key-down), REPEAT (looping), bipolar VELOCITY, legato option.

modules.name: LFO 2
modules.description: LFO with FADE (in or out), wave, SYNC (free, sync, one shot) and RATE; key trigger option.

modules.name: Chorus and reverb
modules.description: Digital chorus (level, four types) and reverb (level, time, LPF and HPF switches).

modules.name: Arpeggiator
modules.description: Up, down, up/down 1 and 2, played, random over 1-6 octaves; swing (±); sync 2nds to 32nds; tap tempo; auto MIDI/USB clock sync; latch via joystick hold.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Stereo line outs (L/mono, R) and headphones; VOLUME; MASTER TUNE.

mod_matrix.note: Each CONTROL has one route: SOURCE (Env 1, LFO 1, Note, Env 2, LFO 2, Full On) multiplied by SCALE (Joystick X, Joystick Y, Aftertouch, Velocity, Pedal, Full On), at the depth of that control's bipolar MOD knob. Route source and scale are NRPN MSB 1-6, LSB 0/1. Source ids 0-5 are SOURCE choices; 6-11 are the SCALE choices (Joystick X ... Full On, scale values 0-5).

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Per path: Osc 1 (+ sub) and Osc 2 (+ density) balanced, then against noise, then against ring mod, into the dual filter with drive, then multi-stage analogue VCAs under Env 1; paths spread in stereo, then chorus and reverb.

behaviours.name: Dual filter
behaviours.rule: OSCar-style: two state-variable filters per path on SSI2164 VCAs. 12 dB modes give one simple filter per voice path (duophonic split); 24 dB modes cascade; Wide Band runs LP and HP in series and Wide Notch in parallel, with WIDTH setting the gap.

behaviours.name: Mod routes
behaviours.rule: Press a CONTROL (Osc 1/2 shape or pitch, cutoff, width), then a SOURCE, then a SCALE (Full On for none): the source times the scale modulates the control at its MOD knob's depth.

behaviours.name: Envelopes and LFOs
behaviours.rule: ADSR with SUST FALL and REPEAT (looping), bipolar velocity, legato triggering; LFOs with fade in/out, sync or one-shot, and key trigger.

behaviours.name: Voicing
behaviours.rule: Mono, Duophonic (two notes, one per signal path, each with its own 12 dB filter) or Quad (four voices across the paths); VOICE SPREAD widens the stereo image; GLIDE with auto (legato) mode.

behaviours.name: Patches
behaviours.rule: 200 locations: bank, tens, ones. INIT gives a single saw; SHIFT + COMPARE randomises; SAVE, location, SAVE stores; SHIFT + bank toggles protection.

source_inconsistencies: The getting started guide calls Mantis 'a sophisticated Duophonic' synth; the specifications say 'Four Voice Polyphonic' with Quad, Duophonic and Mono modes (Quad probably added in firmware).
The specifications list 4 LFO waveshapes; the panel shows more icons and the MIDI chart gives six values.
The specifications list 'LFO Keytrig' twice and leave the Tri and Saw shape descriptions blank.
The patch sheet credits 'DM' for A70-A76 but DM is not in its list of designers.
The specifications describe a 'detune oscillator per voice'; the panel and MIDI chart place Density, Density Rate, Semitone and Cent with Oscillator 2.

modelling_gaps.detail: Only a getting started guide exists; controls come from its top panel image, behaviour from the specifications, numbers from the community MIDI chart.
The two analogue paths are modelled once (per_voice); voicing modes are behaviours.
Six routes with a source and a scale each (schema source_b with multiply); route connections are drawn per source with a scale expression.
